activation_required: Verify the caller repository uses this reviewed contract and passes its delivery tests.
Provision the dedicated key through the approved secret-management path on both sides.
Verify an authenticated delivery, replay, and CRM readback before processing the backlog.
Obtain Owner review for the phone-check capability and rejectExistingCustomer guard before deployment.

items.phone: string, at most 40 characters, 9 to 15 normalized digits

results.receipt: present only for the caller's deterministic retained inquiry activity

rules: One source inquiry creates exactly one customer activity while that activity is retained, including on retry; source UUID spelling is case-insensitive.
Explicit deletion of the receipt activity or its customer ends replay protection and a later delivery can recreate records.
An exact unique normalized primary phone match receives a new activity; do not overwrite its customer profile.
Multiple primary phone matches return ambiguous_phone and create no record.
Phone checks scan every Customer primary phone without writing and expose no customer identifiers unless the deterministic source inquiry activity already exists.
Normalize non-digits and equivalent Korean mobile forms +82 10XXXXXXXX and 010XXXXXXXX for both append matching and checks.
When rejectExistingCustomer is true, replay lookup runs first and any existing normalized primary phone returns phone_exists without writes inside the writer-reserved transaction.
Marketing supplies unknownCustomerName(phone) before read, send, and save when its source name is blank; the provider preserves legacy blank names when a blank name is still received.
Unknown names remain blank; source status remains in activity content.
Read and append only within the fixed source scope. No arbitrary customer updates or deletion.
Interpret original date and minute as Asia/Seoul for CRM date fields and preserve the original strings in activity content.
